description: Researchers examined over 1,500 ancient Peruvian skeletons to understand societal responses to climate disasters. Overall, the study highlights the choices societies make in response to environmental challenges.

description: Life continues in Manipur's relief camps, where the victims of violence confront numerous mental health struggles. An estimated one in eight individuals faces mental illness, with suicides rising among displaced families. Sanitation issues and inadequate living conditions affect both children and adults, exacerbating their trauma. Displacement has shattered families, with many experiencing deep loss and bereavement. As hope diminishes, communities are left to grapple with a bleak future.

The incident occurred as police attempted to arrest him in the Raiganj area of West Bengal. Police stated that Roy opened fire on their team, prompting them to retaliate in self-defense. This marks the fourth police encounter since the BJP assumed power in West Bengal in May.

After initially claiming he suffered a heart attack, police investigations revealed Upendra died of asphyxiation. The couple had frequent arguments about Anita's relationship with Madhusudhan, which escalated the night before the murder. Evidence suggests that Madhusudhan assaulted Upendra while Anita helped to suffocate him.

Tragic incidents have occurred where individuals and families reportedly ended their lives amid mounting debt pressures. The emotional pain and traumatic experiences from debt repayments have left families devastated and grieving.

The contract aims to replace its aging American-made Bell AH-1F Cobra fleet. India is concurrently expanding its own helicopter fleet, focusing on high-altitude combat capabilities. The FAO Cereal Price Index noted a substantial drop, attributed to positive production forecasts and weaker demand. During their national meeting on November 13, they will consider potential limitations on protests, aiming to recommend designated areas that cause minimal disruption. The organization will also tackle trader-related matters, from GST compliance to cyber fraud, advocating for the balance between necessary demonstrations and the continuity of economic activity.

His journey, which began in childhood under the influence of his father's fascination with chess, had seen multiple unsuccessful attempts before this triumph. description: Elon Musk recently clarified that Tesla has no government contracts and SpaceX’s government revenue is declining. Following the Democrats' mid-term election victory, shares of both companies experienced significant declines. Investors are concerned about potential increased scrutiny on Musk's businesses by the new government. Musk confidently stated that he is willing to cancel any unwanted government contracts.
title: Musk issues clarification as Tesla & SpaceX stocks fall over Democrat action fears

author: TNN
description: If India see the keeper-bat as their World Cup No. 5, the time to give him ownership of that position is now instead of using Axar Patel
title: Wanted: Role clarity for KL Rahul

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: An elderly auto-rickshaw driver from Amravati has captured hearts with his impressive command of English. A viral video shows him eloquently discussing travel abroad, inspiring many locals who fondly call him Yadav Chacha. His infectious cheer and remarkable communication skills have drawn comparisons to prominent figures, highlighting how language can bridge gaps and create new opportunities for connection.
title: Amravati auto-driver wins hearts with fluent English and big dreams

author: PRANJAL PANDEY
description: Donald Trump admitted in a recent interview that the Iran war and deportation policies affected Republican midterm results. He acknowledged that while strong border security was supported, harsh deportation measures raised concerns among voters. Trump expressed a willingness to negotiate with Democrats on immigration reform, particularly for long-term residents. He maintained that Iran was prevented from obtaining nuclear weapons during his presidency, asserting military involvement in the region.
title: 'Immigration policy too tough': 5 key takeaways from Trump's 60 minutes interview

author: TNN
description: A late-night argument inside a rented flat in Kolkata resulted in the death of a 25-year-old software engineer. The police have arrested the victim's live-in partner and her mother in connection with the incident. Witnesses reported hearing loud arguments before the attack occurred. The victim was discovered lying in a pool of blood after a woman sought help from neighbors.
title: How a heated argument turned fatal for Kolkata techie; partner, her mom arrested

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Sundar Pichai took to Instagram to share his heartfelt Diwali wishes, showcasing a vibrant rangoli design crafted at Google's Indian office. This stunning art featured the Google logo among elaborately designed patterns, illuminated by glittering diyas. Additionally, Google launched an interactive Lakshmi Puja feature for Diwali searches. Pichai's previous year’s comedic barfi-themed post also captured attention, as his festive social media presence consistently resonates well with audiences.
title: Google CEO Sundar Pichai shares Diwali wishes with Rangoli photo at India office

author: SHIVANGHI PAYAL
description: On Monday, oil prices experienced a downturn following Donald Trump's remarks about military options regarding Iran. He suggested that if negotiations were successful, further military action would likely be avoided. Despite this, concerns linger about potential shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, which continue to threaten global crude supply chains.
title: Brent crude falls over $1 as Trump signals fresh US strikes on Iran are unlikely

author: TOI LIFESTYLE DESK
description: Myra Sharma from Bengaluru and Patna applied lipstick during labor to keep herself occupied. She explained that this personal choice helped her manage discomfort and maintain a sense of self. Understanding labor pain is variable, she acknowledged that every woman's experience is different. Myra shared her perspective on personal freedom during pregnancy and childbirth in her Instagram post.
title: 'Pregnancy is not a disease': Bengaluru mom applies lipstick during labour

author: PRANAV SHUKLA
description: India has decided to retain pacers Arshdeep Singh, Gurnoor Brar, and Auqib Nabi for Test preparations. Batting coach Sitanshu Kotak stated that the ODI series conditions have been beneficial for the upcoming Test matches. A preparatory camp for Test players is scheduled to begin on November 11, which will help them get ready. Meanwhile, India leads the ODI series against New Zealand 2-0 after a close win in Wellington.
title: Arshdeep, Gurnoor Brar, Auqib Nabi to stay back for India’s Test preparations

author: TOI CITY DESK
description: Delhi experienced a significant decline in air quality overnight, with areas recording severe pollution levels. The Central Pollution Control Board reported an Air Quality Index of 406 at ITO, indicating hazardous conditions. Visibility was greatly reduced as a thick layer of smog enveloped the city during the early morning hours. Rajiv Chowk and South Extension also reported very poor air quality readings.
title: Delhi's air quality slips into 'severe' category on Diwali, AQI at 404

author: TNN
description: A three-year-old tigress recently brought to Buxa escaped from her acclimatisation enclosure by digging a hole. This incident occurred shortly after her return from a capture operation in Assam’s Raimona landscape. The escape raises concerns about the enclosure’s security and the challenges of containing a wild tigress. Previously, this tigress had also escaped within days of her initial release in October.
title: 4 days after being brought back, Buxa tigress digs tunnel & flees again

author: GLOBAL SPORTS DESK
description: Tom Brady, the legendary NFL quarterback, made waves in real estate by purchasing a waterfront lot on Indian Creek Island for $17 million. He has since developed it into a stunning estate that's now drawing considerable attention from potential buyers. By January 2025, offers reportedly surpassed $150 million, highlighting the thriving luxury property market in the region. He also secured a remarkable $35 million construction loan for this impressive project.
title: Inside Tom Brady's Miami mansion plans and his billionaire bunker neighbors

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: South Carolina has successfully protected over 62,000 acres of forestland with the Pee Dee Basin Initiative. This initiative represents a significant collaboration among various government and private organizations, totaling an investment of $70 million. The protected areas will support sustainable timber production while preventing incompatible development that undermines ecological integrity. In addition, this initiative will enhance local wildlife habitats and strengthen natural flood defenses for surrounding communities.
title: South Carolina protects 62,000 acres of forest in $70m conservation effort

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Submerged ancient peat forests off Mozambique's coast have transformed into vibrant marine ecosystems, offering vital habitats for diverse marine life. As rising sea levels allowed these forests to sink, they have now integrated with coral reefs, enhancing local biodiversity. The carbon-rich legacy of these underwater realms also holds significant implications for climate strategies, highlighting the necessity of including peat reefs in conservation initiatives.
title: 5,000-year-old underwater peat reefs off Mozambique teem with marine life

description: BJP's Tollygunge MLA Papia Adhikari made claims linking firecrackers to curing diseases during a Kali Puja inauguration. The chief minister, Suvendu Adhikari, emphasized the importance of bursting firecrackers during festival celebrations. He also urged the public to use eco-friendly or green crackers and comply with noise regulations. The significance of firecrackers was highlighted as essential to the Kali Puja festivities.
title: Diwali crackers cure several diseases: BJP MLA
